datasheet.summary: A 240 × 240 color screen with an ST7789 driver chip. The board sends it pixels over SPI.
datasheet.supply: 3.3 V on VCC. The logic pins also use 3.3 V.

pins.GND: Ground. Connect it to the ground of the board.
pins.SCL: SPI clock. The board sets the speed of the data.
pins.SDA: SPI data in (MOSI). The pixels go from the board to the screen on this pin.
pins.RES: Reset. A low signal starts the screen again.
pins.DC: Data or command. Low: the next byte is a command. High: the next byte is pixel data.
pins.CS: Chip select. A low signal tells the screen that the SPI data is for it.
pins.BLK: Backlight control. High turns the backlight on. If you do not control it, connect it to 3.3 V. If it is not connected, the screen can stay black.
